function squeeze(text) {
  return text.replace(/(.)\1+/g, "$1");
}
__name(squeeze, "squeeze");
function variants(raw) {
  const base = raw.normalize("NFKD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/./g, (ch) => homoglyphs[ch] ?? ch);
  const forms = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
  for (const one of ["i", "l"]) {
    const text = base.replace(/[0-9]/g, (d) => d === "1" ? one : leet[d]).replace(/[^a-z]/g, "");
    forms.add(text);
    forms.add(text.replace(/k/g, "c").replace(/[yj]/g, "i").replace(/ph/g, "f").replace(/w/g, "v"));
    forms.add(text.replace(/x/g, "cs"));
  }
  return [...forms].map((plain) => ({ plain, squeezed: squeeze(plain) }));
}
__name(variants, "variants");
var rules = banned.map(([root, allow = [], raw = false]) => ({
  raw,
  root: raw ? root : squeeze(root),
  allow: raw ? allow : allow.map(squeeze)
}));
var digitRules = [/14\W*88/, /k\W*k\W*k/i];
function inappropriateName(nickname) {
  const name = String(nickname ?? "");
  if (digitRules.some((rule) => rule.test(name))) return true;
  return variants(name).some((form) => rules.some(({ raw, root, allow }) => {
    const text = raw ? form.plain : form.squeezed;
    if (!text.includes(root)) return false;
    let rest = text;
    for (const word of allow) rest = rest.split(word).join("#");
    return rest.includes(root);
  }));
}
__name(inappropriateName, "inappropriateName");

// worker/population.js
var POPULATION_ROUNDS = 10;
var MIN_RATIO = 1.05;
var MAX_RATIO = 3;
var POPULATION_BANDS = [
  { id: "hard", min: MIN_RATIO, max: 1.35, count: 3 },
  { id: "medium", min: 1.35, max: 1.9, count: 4 },
  { id: "easy", min: 1.9, max: MAX_RATIO, count: 3 }
];
var byId = new Map(population_countries_default.countries.map((country) => [country.id, country]));
var populationCountry = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((id) => byId.get(id), "populationCountry");
var populationRatio = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((a, b) => Math.max(a.population, b.population) / Math.min(a.population, b.population), "populationRatio");
var populationBand = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((a, b) => {
  const ratio = populationRatio(a, b);
  return POPULATION_BANDS.find((band) => ratio >= band.min && ratio < band.max)?.id ?? (ratio === MAX_RATIO ? "easy" : null);
}, "populationBand");
var randomInt = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((n) => crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0] % n, "randomInt");
function shuffle(items, random) {
  for (let i = items.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = random(i + 1);
    [items[i], items[j]] = [items[j], items[i]];
  }
  return items;
}
__name(shuffle, "shuffle");
var candidates = Object.fromEntries(POPULATION_BANDS.map((band) => [band.id, []]));
for (const [i, a] of population_countries_default.countries.entries())
  for (const b of population_countries_default.countries.slice(i + 1)) {
    const band = populationBand(a, b);
    if (band) candidates[band].push([a.id, b.id]);
  }
function drawPopulationPairs(random = randomInt) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 500; attempt++) {
    const bands = shuffle(POPULATION_BANDS.flatMap((band) => Array(band.count).fill(band.id)), random);
    if (bands.some((band, i) => i > 1 && band === bands[i - 1] && band === bands[i - 2])) continue;
    const used = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
    const pairs = [];
    for (const band of bands) {
      const pool = candidates[band].filter(([a, b]) => !used.has(a) && !used.has(b));
      if (!pool.length) break;
      const pair = [...pool[random(pool.length)]];
      if (random(2)) pair.reverse();
      pair.forEach((id) => used.add(id));
      pairs.push(pair);
    }
    if (pairs.length === POPULATION_ROUNDS) return pairs;
  }
  throw new Error("Impossibile estrarre i confronti sulla popolazione");
}
__name(drawPopulationPairs, "drawPopulationPairs");
var populationYear = population_countries_default.year;

var CHRONOLOGY_ROUNDS = categories.length;
function drawChronology() {
  return categories.map(([category, entries]) => {
    const pool = [...entries];
    const items = Array.from({ length: 4 }, (_, id) => {
      const index = Math.floor(Math.random() * pool.length);
      const [[name, year]] = pool.splice(index, 1);
      return { id, name, year };
    });
    return { category, items };
  });
}
__name(drawChronology, "drawChronology");
function correctChronology(items) {
  return [...items].sort((a, b) => a.year - b.year).map(({ id }) => id);
}
__name(correctChronology, "correctChronology");

var VAULT_ROUNDS = 6;
var VAULT_DURATION = 2e4;
var VAULT_REVEAL = 8e3;
var VAULT_SOLUTION_AT = 3e3;
var VAULT_NEXT = 7500;
var VAULT_MAX_POINTS = 200;
var ANNOUNCEMENT_MS = 0;
var preview = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((round) => round === 1 ? 1e3 : 800, "preview");
var vaultIntro = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((round) => (round === 1 ? ANNOUNCEMENT_MS : 0) + preview(round), "vaultIntro");
var min = 1;
var max = 99999999;
var vaultQuestion = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((id) => catalog.find((question) => question.id === id), "vaultQuestion");
var validGuess = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((value) => Number.isSafeInteger(value) && value >= min && value <= max, "validGuess");
function vaultPoints(guess, solution) {
  const ratio = Math.max(guess, solution) / Math.min(guess, solution);
  const base = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round(100 * (1 - Math.log10(ratio)))));
  return base * (VAULT_MAX_POINTS / 100);
}
__name(vaultPoints, "vaultPoints");
function shuffle2(items) {
  for (let i = items.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0] % (i + 1);
    [items[i], items[j]] = [items[j], items[i]];
  }
  return items;
}
__name(shuffle2, "shuffle");
function drawVault() {
  const ids = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((difficulty) => shuffle2(catalog.filter((q) => q.difficulty === difficulty).map((q) => q.id)), "ids");
  return shuffle2([...ids("facile").slice(0, 2), ...ids("media").slice(0, 4)]);
}
__name(drawVault, "drawVault");
function publicVault({ id, category, difficulty, prompt, mobile, unit, effect }, round) {
  return {
    id,
    category,
    difficulty,
    prompt,
    mobile,
    unit,
    effect,
    min,
    max,
    intro_ms: vaultIntro(round),
    preview_ms: preview(round),
    max_points: VAULT_MAX_POINTS
  };
}
__name(publicVault, "publicVault");
function settleVault(r, { solution, explanation, source, popup }, early = false, addPoints2 = (room, id, points) => {
  room.players[id].score += points;
}) {
  const entries = Object.entries(r.answers);
  const spread = /* @__PURE__ */ new Map();
  const byDistance = /* @__PURE__ */ __name(([, a], [, b]) => {
    const left = BigInt(Math.max(a.choice, solution)) * BigInt(Math.min(b.choice, solution));
    const right = BigInt(Math.max(b.choice, solution)) * BigInt(Math.min(a.choice, solution));
    return (left > right) - (left < right);
  }, "byDistance");
  entries.sort((a, b) => byDistance(a, b) || r.players[a[0]].nickname.localeCompare(r.players[b[0]].nickname));
  const podium = [];
  let rank = 0;
  entries.forEach(([id, answer], i) => {
    if (!i || byDistance(entries[i - 1], entries[i])) rank = i + 1;
    const { choice } = answer;
    const points = vaultPoints(choice, solution);
    Object.assign(answer, { rank, points });
    addPoints2(r, id, points);
    spread.set(choice, (spread.get(choice) || 0) + 1);
    if (rank <= 3) {
      if (podium.at(-1)?.rank !== rank) podium.push({ rank, points, players: [] });
      podium.at(-1).players.push({ nickname: r.players[id].nickname, choice });
    }
  });
  r.vaultResult = {
    solution,
    explanation,
    source,
    popup,
    podium,
    early,
    max_points: VAULT_MAX_POINTS,
    distribution: [...spread].sort(([a], [b]) => a - b)
  };
}
__name(settleVault, "settleVault");

// worker/pokeprice.js
var PRICE_START = 13;
var PRICE_ROUNDS = 12;
var PRICE_DURATION = 15e3;
function validComparison(reference, candidate) {
  return Math.abs(candidate.cents - reference.cents) * 20 >= reference.cents;
}
__name(validComparison, "validComparison");
function validatePricePool(cards) {
  const count = PRICE_ROUNDS + 1;
  const sorted = [...cards].sort((a, b) => a.cents - b.cents);
  const low = sorted.slice(0, Math.ceil(count / 2));
  const high = sorted.slice(-Math.floor(count / 2));
  if (cards.length < count || !validComparison(high[0], low.at(-1)))
    throw Error("Pok\xE9Price: non ci sono abbastanza carte con prezzi confrontabili");
  return { low, high };
}
__name(validatePricePool, "validatePricePool");
function selectPriceCards(cards, random = Math.random) {
  const count = PRICE_ROUNDS + 1;
  const shuffle4 = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((items) => {
    const shuffled = [...items];
    for (let i = shuffled.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(random() * (i + 1));
      [shuffled[i], shuffled[j]] = [shuffled[j], shuffled[i]];
    }
    return shuffled;
  }, "shuffle");
  const pool = shuffle4(cards);
  const selected = [pool.shift()];
  while (selected.length < count) {
    const next = pool.findIndex((card) => validComparison(selected.at(-1), card));
    if (next === -1) break;
    selected.push(pool.splice(next, 1)[0]);
  }
  if (selected.length === count) return selected;
  const fallback = validatePricePool(cards);
  const low = shuffle4(fallback.low);
  const high = shuffle4(fallback.high);
  return low.flatMap((card, i) => i < high.length ? [card, high[i]] : [card]);
}
__name(selectPriceCards, "selectPriceCards");
function priceCards(room) {
  const index = room.round - PRICE_START;
  return [room.priceOrder[index], room.priceOrder[index + 1]];
}
__name(priceCards, "priceCards");
function priceDirection(reference, candidate) {
  return candidate.cents > reference.cents ? "higher" : "lower";
}
__name(priceDirection, "priceDirection");
function settlePrice(room) {
  const correct = priceDirection(...priceCards(room));
  for (const [id, player] of Object.entries(room.players)) {
    const answer = room.answers[id];
    const won = answer?.choice === correct;
    player.streak = won ? (player.streak || 0) + 1 : 0;
    if (!answer) continue;
    answer.result = won ? "correct" : "wrong";
    answer.bonus = won && player.streak % 3 === 0 ? 20 : 0;
    answer.points = (won ? 100 : -50) + answer.bonus;
    player.score += answer.points;
  }
}
__name(settlePrice, "settlePrice");
function priceSnapshot(room, revealed) {
  const [reference, candidate] = priceCards(room);
  return {
    round: room.round - PRICE_START + 1,
    total: PRICE_ROUNDS,
    reference,
    candidate: revealed ? candidate : {
      id: candidate.id,
      name: candidate.name,
      set: candidate.set,
      number: candidate.number,
      image: candidate.image
    },
    direction: revealed ? priceDirection(reference, candidate) : null,
    correct: revealed ? Object.values(room.answers).filter((answer) => answer.result === "correct").length : null
  };
}
__name(priceSnapshot, "priceSnapshot");

var MEADOW_ROUNDS = 5;

var MEADOW_CATEGORIES = categories2.length;
function shuffle3(items) {
  for (let i = items.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0] % (i + 1);
    [items[i], items[j]] = [items[j], items[i]];
  }
  return items;
}
__name(shuffle3, "shuffle");
var pick = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((list, count) => shuffle3([...list]).slice(0, count), "pick");
function drawMeadow() {
  return pick(categories2, MEADOW_ROUNDS).map(([category, safe, bombs]) => {
    const names = shuffle3([...pick(safe, MEADOW_OPTIONS - 1).map((name) => ({ name, bomb: false })), { name: pick(bombs, 1)[0], bomb: true }]);
    const items = names.map((item, id) => ({ id, ...item }));
    if (items.length !== MEADOW_OPTIONS || items.filter((item) => item.bomb).length !== 1 || new Set(items.map((item) => item.name)).size !== MEADOW_OPTIONS)
      throw new Error(`Prato fiorito: round non valido per ${category}`);
    return { category, items };
  });
}

function rankings(r, connected, extra = () => ({})) {

var token = /* @__PURE__ */ __name(() => [...crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(32))].map((n) => n.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(""), "token");
var hash = /* @__PURE__ */ __name(async (value) => [
  ...new Uint8Array(
    await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256", new TextEncoder().encode(value))
  )
].map((n) => n.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join(""), "hash");
var cookie = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((value) => `__Host-goku=${value}; Path=/; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict; Max-Age=${value ? 365 * 86400 : 0}`, "cookie");
var normalize = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((s) => s.normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "").toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, ""), "normalize");
var canonical = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((name) => name === "codaurlante" ? "screamtail" : name, "canonical");
function resolveName(text) {
  const input = normalize(text);
  if (quiz_default.names.includes(input)) return canonical(input);
  let best = Infinity, matches = [];
  for (const name of quiz_default.names) {
    const limit = name.length >= 8 ? 2 : name.length >= 4 ? 1 : 0;
    if (Math.abs(input.length - name.length) > limit) continue;
    let row = Array.from({ length: name.length + 1 }, (_, i) => i);
    for (let i = 1; i <= input.length; i++) {
      const next = [i];
      for (let j = 1; j <= name.length; j++)
        next[j] = Math.min(
          next[j - 1] + 1,
          row[j] + 1,
          row[j - 1] + (input[i - 1] !== name[j - 1])
        );
      row = next;
    }
    const d = row[name.length];
    if (d > limit || d > best) continue;
    if (d < best) {
      best = d;
      matches = [];
    }
    matches.push(name);
  }
  return matches.length === 1 ? canonical(matches[0]) : null;
}
__name(resolveName, "resolveName");
var index_default = {
  async fetch(request, env) {
    const url = new URL(request.url);
    if (!url.pathname.startsWith("/api/")) return env.ASSETS.fetch(request);
    try {
      if (request.headers.get("Origin") !== url.origin)
        fail("Origine non autorizzata");
      if (url.pathname !== "/api/rpc" && url.pathname !== "/api/socket")
        fail("Non trovato", 404);
      if (url.pathname === "/api/rpc" && (request.method !== "POST" || !request.headers.get("Content-Type")?.startsWith("application/json")))
        fail("Richiesta non valida", 400);
      const rawCookie = request.headers.get("Cookie")?.match(/(?:^|;\s*)__Host-goku=([a-f0-9]{64})(?:;|$)/)?.[1] || "";
      const session = rawCookie ? await hash(rawCookie) : "";
      if (url.pathname === "/api/socket") {
        if (request.headers.get("Upgrade")?.toLowerCase() !== "websocket")
          fail("WebSocket richiesto", 400);
        return await env.GOKU.getByName("goku").fetch(
          new Request(
            "https://internal/socket?room=" + encodeURIComponent(url.searchParams.get("room") || ""),
            { headers: { Upgrade: "websocket", "X-Session": session } }
          )
        );
      }
      const raw = await request.text();
      if (raw.length > 4096) fail("Richiesta troppo grande", 413);
      let body;
      try {
        body = JSON.parse(raw);
      } catch {
        fail("Richiesta non valida", 400);
      }
      const { action, payload = {} } = body || {};
      if (typeof action !== "string") fail("Richiesta non valida", 400);
      if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object" || Array.isArray(payload))
        fail("Dati non validi", 400);
      const secret = token(), invite = token();
      const auth = {
        session,
        newHash: await hash(secret),
        inviteHash: await hash(invite),
        ip: await hash(request.headers.get("CF-Connecting-IP") || "local")
      };
      if (action === "login") {
        const supplied = await hash(String(payload.password || "")), expected = await hash(env.ADMIN_PASSWORD || token());
        let diff = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < expected.length; i++)
          diff |= supplied.charCodeAt(i) ^ expected.charCodeAt(i);
        auth.passwordOK = !!env.ADMIN_PASSWORD && diff === 0;
        delete payload.password;
      }
      if (action === "redeem") {
        auth.tokenHash = await hash(String(payload.token || ""));
        delete payload.token;
      }
      const response = await env.GOKU.getByName("goku").fetch(
        "https://internal/rpc",
        { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify({ action, payload, auth }) }
      );
      const data = await response.json();
      const headers = {};
      if (data.setSession) {
        headers["Set-Cookie"] = cookie(secret);
        delete data.setSession;
      }
      if (data.clearSession) {
        headers["Set-Cookie"] = cookie("");
        delete data.clearSession;
      }
      if (data.invite) {
        data.token = invite;
        delete data.invite;
      }
      return json(data, response.status, headers);
    } catch (e) {
      return e.status ? json({ error: e.message }, e.status) : unavailable();
    }
  }
};
var Goku = class {
  static {
    __name(this, "Goku");
  }
  constructor(ctx, env) {
    this.ctx = ctx;
    this.env = env;
    this.sql = ctx.storage.sql;
    this.sql.exec(
      "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records (kind TEXT, id TEXT, data TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(kind,id))"
    );
  }
  get(kind, id) {
    const r = this.sql.exec("SELECT data FROM records WHERE kind=? AND id=?", kind, id).toArray()[0];
    return r ? JSON.parse(r.data) : null;
  }
  put(kind, id, data) {
    this.sql.exec(
      "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO records VALUES(?,?,?)",
      kind,
      id,
      JSON.stringify(data)
    );
  }
  del(kind, id) {
    this.sql.exec("DELETE FROM records WHERE kind=? AND id=?", kind, id);
  }
  all(kind) {
    return this.sql.exec("SELECT data FROM records WHERE kind=?", kind).toArray().map((r) => JSON.parse(r.data));
  }
  session(key) {
    const s = this.get("session", key);
    return s && s.expires > Date.now() ? s : null;
  }
  async adminSessionKey(key) {
    if (!this.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD) return "";
    const encoder = new TextEncoder();
    this.adminSigningKey ??= crypto.subtle.importKey(
      "raw",
      encoder.encode(this.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD),
      { name: "HMAC", hash: "SHA-256" },
      false,
      ["sign"]
    );
    const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign("HMAC", await this.adminSigningKey, encoder.encode(key));
    return "admin:" + [...new Uint8Array(signature)].map((n) => n.toString(16).padStart(2, "0")).join("");
  }
  async sessionKey(key) {
    if (!key) return "";
    const s = this.session(key);
    return s && s.role !== "admin" ? key : this.adminSessionKey(key);
  }
  pruneTemporaryRecords(now) {
    if (now < this.nextPruneAt) return;
    this.sql.exec(
      `DELETE FROM records
       WHERE (kind = 'rate' AND json_extract(data, '$.until') <= ?)
          OR (kind = 'session' AND json_extract(data, '$.expires') <= ?)`,
      now,
      now
    );
    this.nextPruneAt = now + 36e5;
  }
  license(s) {
    return s?.license ? this.get("license", s.license) : null;
  }
  control(s, r) {
    const l = this.license(s);
    return !!s && (s.role === "admin" || s.id === r.host_id && l && !l.revoked && (r.phase !== "lobby" || l.expires > Date.now()));
  }
  readable(s, r) {
    return s && r && (s.role === "admin" || s.id === r.host_id || r.players[s.id]);
  }
  publicRoom(r) {
    const { players, answers, order, population_pairs, clueOrder, priceOrder, chronologyOrder, chronology_points, vaultOrder, meadowOrder, vaultResult, polling, settled, ...publicData } = r;
    publicData.quiz ||= "pokemon";
    publicData.manche ||= publicData.quiz === "culture" ? 1 : "cards";
    if (publicData.quiz === "culture") publicData.manche_total = meadowOrder ? cultureStages.length : vaultOrder ? 3 : 2;
    return publicData;
  }
  advanceRound(r, now = Date.now()) {
    if (quizOf(r) === "pokemon") {
      if ((r.manche ?? "cards") === "cards" && r.round === 6) return this.beginClues(r);
      if (r.manche === "clues" && r.round === PRICE_START - 1) return this.beginPrice(r);
    }
    if (r.round === rounds(r)) {
      if (cultureStage(r)?.id === "population") {
        r.manche = 2;
        r.chronologyOrder ??= drawChronology();
      } else if (isChronology(r) && r.vaultOrder) {
        r.manche = 3;
      } else if (isVault(r) && r.meadowOrder) {
        r.manche = 4;
      } else {
        r.phase = "finished";
        return;
      }
      r.round = r.settled = 0;
    }
    if (quizOf(r) === "culture" && r.round === 0 && r.phase !== "intro") {
      r.phase = "intro";
      r.remaining_ms = 0;
      r.deadline = null;
      r.answers = {};
      return;
    }
    r.round++;
    r.phase = "question";
    delete r.chronology_view;
    if (isChronology(r)) r.chronology_points = CHRONOLOGY_POINTS;
    if (isVault(r)) delete r.vaultResult;
    r.starts_at = now + (isVault(r) ? vaultIntro(r.round) : isChronology(r) ? CHRONOLOGY_INTRO : isMeadow(r) ? MEADOW_INTRO : r.manche === "price" ? 0 : 2e3);
    r.remaining_ms = roundDuration(r);
    r.deadline = r.starts_at + r.remaining_ms;
    r.answers = {};
    r.cluesShown = 0;
  }
  chronologyParticipants(r, connected = this.connectedPlayers(r)) {
    const cutoff = Date.now() - POLL_PRESENCE_MS;
    return Object.keys(r.players).filter((id) => connected.has(id) || r.polling?.[id] > cutoff);
  }
  connectedPlayers(r) {
    return new Set(this.ctx.getWebSockets(r.id).filter((ws) => ws.readyState === 1).map((ws) => ws.deserializeAttachment()?.user));
  }
  recordPoll(r, id, now) {
    if (quizOf(r) !== "culture" || r.phase === "finished" || !r.players[id] || this.connectedPlayers(r).has(id)) return false;
    r.polling ??= {};
    r.polling[id] = now;
    return true;
  }
  settle(r, force = false, now = Date.now()) {
    let changed = false;
    const complete = /* @__PURE__ */ __name(() => {
      const ids = isTimeline(r) ? this.chronologyParticipants(r) : Object.keys(r.players);
      return ids.length > 0 && ids.every((id) => r.answers[id]?.done);
    }, "complete");
    const allAnswered = r.phase === "question" && now >= r.starts_at && now < r.deadline && complete();
    if (r.phase === "question" && (r.deadline <= now || allAnswered)) {
      if (quizOf(r) === "culture") {
        if (isChronology(r)) {
          r.chronology_view = "solution";
          r.remaining_ms = 0;
          r.deadline = null;
        } else {
          r.remaining_ms = isVault(r) ? VAULT_REVEAL - (allAnswered ? VAULT_SOLUTION_AT : 0) : isMeadow(r) ? MEADOW_REVEAL : 1e4;
          r.deadline = now + r.remaining_ms;
        }

      r.revision++;
      changed = true;

    if ((force || ["reveal", "finished"].includes(r.phase)) && r.settled < r.round) {
      if (isVault(r)) settleVault(r, this.question(r), allAnswered, addPoints);
      else if (r.manche === "price") settlePrice(r);
      else for (const [id, a] of Object.entries(r.answers))
        addPoints(r, id, a.points || 0);
      r.settled = r.round;
      changed = true;
    }
    if (!force && quizOf(r) === "culture" && r.phase === "reveal" && r.deadline !== null && r.deadline <= now) {
      this.advanceRound(r, now);
      r.revision++;
      changed = true;
    }
    if (r.manche === "clues" && r.phase === "question") {
      const count = Date.now() < r.starts_at ? 0 : r.deadline - Date.now() > 2e4 ? 1 : r.deadline - Date.now() > 1e4 ? 2 : 3;
      if (count !== (r.cluesShown || 0)) {
        r.cluesShown = count;
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    if (!force && quizOf(r) === "pokemon" && (r.manche ?? "cards") === "cards" && r.round === 6 && r.phase === "reveal") {
      this.advanceRound(r, now);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (!force && quizOf(r) === "pokemon" && r.manche === "clues" && r.round === PRICE_START - 1 && r.phase === "reveal") {
      this.advanceRound(r, now);
      changed = true;
    }
    if (changed) this.put("room", r.id, r);
    return changed;
  }
  beginClues(r) {

    }
    r.clueOrder = r.clueOrder.slice(0, 6);
    r.round = 7;
    r.settled = 6;
    r.answers = {};

    r.starts_at = Date.now() + 5e3;
    r.deadline = r.starts_at + 3e4;
    r.remaining_ms = 3e4;
    r.revision++;
  }
  beginPrice(r) {

    r.manche = "price";
    r.round = PRICE_START;
    r.settled = PRICE_START - 1;

    r.remaining_ms = roundDuration(r);

  }
  question(r) {

  }
  vaultShared(r) {
    const connected = this.connectedPlayers(r);

  snapshot(s, r, shared) {
    if (!this.readable(s, r)) fail("Stanza non accessibile");
    if (isVault(r) && r.phase !== "intro") {

        } : null,

      };
    }

  async broadcast(room) {
    const sockets = this.ctx.getWebSockets(room);
    const keys = await Promise.all(sockets.map((ws) => this.sessionKey(ws.deserializeAttachment()?.session)));
    const r = this.get("room", room);
    if (!r) return;
    const shared = isVault(r) && r.phase !== "intro" ? this.vaultShared(r) : void 0;
    for (const [i, ws] of sockets.entries()) {
      const s = this.session(keys[i]);
      try {
        if (this.readable(s, r)) ws.send(JSON.stringify(this.snapshot(s, r, shared)));
        else ws.close(1008, "Sessione o accesso non valido");
      } catch {
        console.warn("Goku: invio WebSocket non riuscito");
      }
    }
  }
  async schedule() {
    const deadlines = this.all("room").filter((r) => r.phase === "question" || quizOf(r) === "culture" && r.phase === "reveal" && r.deadline !== null).map((r) => r.phase === "question" && r.manche === "clues" ? [r.starts_at, r.deadline - 2e4, r.deadline - 1e4, r.deadline].find((time) => time > Date.now()) || r.deadline : r.deadline);
    const next = deadlines.length ? Math.min(...deadlines) : null;
    if (await this.ctx.storage.getAlarm() !== next) {
      if (next) await this.ctx.storage.setAlarm(next);
      else await this.ctx.storage.deleteAlarm();
    }
  }
  async fetch(request) {
    return this.ctx.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
      try {
        if (new URL(request.url).pathname === "/socket") {
          const key = request.headers.get("X-Session"), s = this.session(await this.sessionKey(key)), id = new URL(request.url).searchParams.get("room"), r = this.get("room", id);
          if (!this.readable(s, r)) fail("Stanza non accessibile");
          if (this.ctx.getWebSockets().length >= 500)
            fail("Troppe connessioni", 429);
          const pair = new WebSocketPair();
          this.ctx.acceptWebSocket(pair[1], [id]);
          pair[1].serializeAttachment({ session: key, user: s.id, room: id });
          if (r.polling?.[s.id]) {
            delete r.polling[s.id];
            this.put("room", r.id, r);
          }
          this.settle(r);
          await this.broadcast(id);
          await this.schedule();
          return new Response(null, { status: 101, webSocket: pair[0] });
        }
        const { action, payload, auth } = await request.json();
        this.pruneTemporaryRecords(Date.now());
        auth.session = await this.sessionKey(auth.session);
        if (action === "login" && auth.passwordOK) auth.newHash = await this.adminSessionKey(auth.newHash);
        this.changed = /* @__PURE__ */ new Set();
        const now = Date.now();
        for (const r of this.all("room"))
          if (this.settle(r, false, now)) this.changed.add(r.id);
        let data, status = 200;
        try {
          data = this.ctx.storage.transactionSync(
            () => this.dispatch(action, payload, auth, now)
          );
        } catch (e) {
          if (!e.status) return unavailable();
          data = { error: e.message };
          status = e.status;
        }
        for (const id of this.changed) await this.broadcast(id);
        await this.schedule();
        return json(data, status);
      } catch (e) {
        return e.status ? json({ error: e.message }, e.status) : unavailable();
      }
    });
  }
  dispatch(action, p, a, now = Date.now()) {
    const s = this.session(a.session), admin = s?.role === "admin";
    const requireAdmin = /* @__PURE__ */ __name(() => {
      if (!admin) fail("Solo Admin");
    }, "requireAdmin");
    const newSession = /* @__PURE__ */ __name((role, license = null) => {
      const session = {
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        role,
        license,
        expires: now + 365 * DAY
      };
      this.put("session", a.newHash, session);
      return session;
    }, "newSession");
    if (action === "login") {
      const rate = this.get("rate", a.ip) || { count: 0, until: 0 };
      if (rate.until > now && rate.count >= 5)
        fail("Troppi tentativi. Riprova tra 15 minuti.", 429);
      if (!a.passwordOK) {
        if (rate.until <= now) {
          rate.count = 0;
          rate.until = now + 15 * 6e4;
        }
        rate.count++;
        this.put("rate", a.ip, rate);
        return { error: "Password errata" };
      }
      this.del("rate", a.ip);
      if (a.session) this.del("session", a.session);
      newSession("admin");
      return { setSession: true };
    }
    if (action === "logout") {
      this.del("session", a.session);
      for (const r2 of this.all("room")) this.changed.add(r2.id);
      return { clearSession: true };
    }
    if (action === "identity") {
      if (s) return { id: s.id, role: s.role };
      const player = newSession("player");
      return { id: player.id, role: player.role, setSession: true };
    }
    if (action === "redeem") {
      const l = this.all("license").find((l2) => l2.token_hash === a.tokenHash);
      if (!l) fail("Invito non valido");
      if (l.revoked) fail("Invito revocato");
      if (l.expires <= now) fail("Invito scaduto");
      if (l.redeemed) fail("Invito gi\xE0 riscattato");
      const host = newSession("host", l.id);
      l.redeemed = host.id;
      this.put("license", l.id, l);
      return { setSession: true };
    }
    if (!s) fail("Autenticazione necessaria", 401);
    if (action === "license_create") {
      requireAdmin();
      const hours = Number(p.hours), quota = Number(p.max_rooms);
      if (!Number.isFinite(hours) || hours <= 0 || hours > 8760 || !Number.isInteger(quota) || quota < 1 || quota > 1e4)
        fail("Durata o quota non valida", 400);
      if (p.name !== void 0 && (typeof p.name !== "string" || p.name.trim().length > 80))
        fail("Nome della licenza non valido (massimo 80 caratteri)", 400);
      const quizzes = p.quizzes ?? ["pokemon"];
      if (!Array.isArray(quizzes) || !quizzes.length || quizzes.some((q) => !["pokemon", "culture"].includes(q)) || new Set(quizzes).size !== quizzes.length)
        fail("Seleziona almeno un quiz valido", 400);
      const l = {
        name: (p.name || "").trim(),
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        token_hash: a.inviteHash,
        expires: now + hours * 36e5,
        created: now,
        max_rooms: quota,
        quizzes,
        used_rooms: 0,
        revoked: false,
        redeemed: null
      };
      this.put("license", l.id, l);
      return { id: l.id, invite: true };
    }
    if (action === "license_revoke") {
      requireAdmin();
      const l = this.get("license", p.license_id);
      if (!l) fail("Licenza inesistente", 404);
      l.revoked = true;
      this.put("license", l.id, l);
      for (const r2 of this.all("room"))
        if (r2.license_id === l.id) this.changed.add(r2.id);
      return { ok: true };
    }
    if (action === "dashboard") {
      if (s.role === "player") fail("Solo Admin o Host");
      return {
        admin,
        licenses: this.all("license").filter((l) => admin || l.id === s.license).map((l) => ({
          id: l.id,
          name: l.name || "",
          starts_at: l.created,
          expires_at: l.expires,
          max_rooms: l.max_rooms,
          used_rooms: l.used_rooms,
          quizzes: l.quizzes || ["pokemon"],
          redeemed: !!l.redeemed,
          status: l.revoked ? "revocato" : l.expires <= now ? "scaduto" : l.redeemed ? "attivo" : "disponibile"
        })),
        rooms: this.all("room").filter((r2) => admin || r2.host_id === s.id).map((r2) => this.publicRoom(r2))
      };
    }
    if (action === "create") {
      const selectedQuiz = p.quiz ?? "pokemon";
      if (!["pokemon", "culture"].includes(selectedQuiz)) fail("Quiz non valido", 400);
      if (p.name_filter !== void 0 && typeof p.name_filter !== "boolean") fail("Filtro nomi non valido", 400);
      const license = admin ? null : this.license(s);
      if (!admin && !(license?.quizzes || ["pokemon"]).includes(selectedQuiz)) fail("Quiz non incluso nella licenza");
      if (!admin) {
        const l = license;
        if (s.role !== "host" || !l || l.revoked || l.expires <= now)
          fail("Licenza assente, scaduta o revocata");
        if (l.used_rooms >= l.max_rooms) fail("Quota esaurita");
        l.used_rooms++;
        this.put("license", l.id, l);
      }
      const existing = new Set(this.all("room").map((r3) => r3.code));
      let code;
      for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
        code = String(
          1e5 + crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0] % 9e5
        );
        if (!existing.has(code)) break;
        code = null;
      }
      if (!code) fail("PIN esauriti");
      const order = quiz_default.cards.map((_, i) => i);
      for (let i = order.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
        const j = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint32Array(1))[0] % (i + 1);
        [order[i], order[j]] = [order[j], order[i]];
      }
      const r2 = {
        id: crypto.randomUUID(),
        code,
        host_id: s.id,
        license_id: admin ? null : s.license,
        quiz: selectedQuiz,
        phase: "lobby",
        round: 0,
        manche: selectedQuiz === "culture" ? 1 : "cards",
        revision: 0,
        starts_at: null,
        deadline: null,
        remaining_ms: 3e4,
        settled: 0,
        players: {},
        answers: {},
        name_filter: p.name_filter !== false,
        ...selectedQuiz === "culture" ? { population_year: populationYear, population_pairs: drawPopulationPairs(), chronologyOrder: drawChronology(), vaultOrder: drawVault(), meadowOrder: drawMeadow() } : {},
        ...selectedQuiz === "pokemon" ? { order, priceOrder: selectPriceCards(quiz_default.priceCards) } : {}
      };
      this.put("room", r2.id, r2);
      return { id: r2.id, code };
    }
    if (action === "join") {
      const r2 = this.all("room").find((r3) => r3.code === p.code);
      if (!r2) fail("Stanza inesistente", 404);
      if (r2.players[s.id]) return { id: r2.id };
      if (r2.phase === "finished") fail("Partita terminata");
      if (Object.keys(r2.players).length >= 100) fail("Stanza piena");
      const nickname = String(p.nickname || "").trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ");
      if (!/^[\p{L}\p{N} _.-]{1,24}$/u.test(nickname))
        fail("Nickname non valido");
      if (r2.name_filter !== false && inappropriateName(nickname))
        fail("Questo nickname non \xE8 consentito. Scegline un altro.");
      if (Object.values(r2.players).some(
        (x) => x.nickname.toLowerCase() === nickname.toLowerCase()
      ))
        fail("Nickname gi\xE0 utilizzato");
      r2.players[s.id] = { user_id: s.id, nickname, score: 0 };
      this.recordPoll(r2, s.id, now);
      r2.revision++;
      this.put("room", r2.id, r2);
      this.changed.add(r2.id);
      return { id: r2.id };
    }
    const r = this.get("room", p.room_id);
    if (!this.readable(s, r)) fail("Stanza non accessibile");
    if (action === "state") {
      const becameActive = isVault(r) && !(r.polling?.[s.id] > now - POLL_PRESENCE_MS);
      if (this.recordPoll(r, s.id, now)) {
        this.put("room", r.id, r);
        if (becameActive) this.changed.add(r.id);
      }
      return this.snapshot(s, r);
    }
    if (action === "card") {
      if (!this.control(s, r) || quizOf(r) !== "pokemon" || !r.round || ["clues", "price"].includes(r.manche))
        fail("Solo il conduttore pu\xF2 vedere la carta");
      return { asset: quiz_default.cards[r.order[r.round - 1]].opaque };
    }
    if (action === "answer") {
      if (!r.players[s.id]) fail("Solo giocatori");
      if (p.round !== r.round || (isVault(r) || isTimeline(r) || p.manche === 3) && p.manche !== r.manche) fail("Domanda non pi\xF9 attuale");
      const answer = r.answers[s.id] || {
        attempts: 0,
        done: false,
        points: 0,
        requests: {}
      };
      if (typeof p.request_id !== "string" || !/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(p.request_id))
        fail("Identificativo richiesta necessario");
      if (isVault(r)) {
        if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(p.request_id))
          fail("Identificativo richiesta non valido");
        if (!validGuess(p.answer)) fail("Inserisci un intero da 1 a 99.999.999", 400);
        const receipt = answer.requests[p.request_id];
        if (receipt) {
          if (receipt.choice !== p.answer) fail("La richiesta contiene una stima diversa");
          return receipt;
        }
        if (answer.done) fail("Risposta gi\xE0 bloccata");
        if (r.phase !== "question" || now < r.starts_at || now >= r.deadline) fail("Risposte chiuse o timer in pausa");
        const result2 = { done: true, choice: p.answer };
        r.answers[s.id] = { ...result2, requests: { [p.request_id]: result2 } };
        this.recordPoll(r, s.id, now);
        if (!this.settle(r, false, now)) {
          r.revision++;
          this.put("room", r.id, r);
        }
        this.changed.add(r.id);
        return result2;
      }
      if (answer.requests[p.request_id]) return answer.requests[p.request_id];
      if (r.phase !== "question" || now < r.starts_at || now >= r.deadline)
        fail("Risposte chiuse o timer in pausa");
      if (answer.done) fail("Hai gi\xE0 completato questa domanda");
      if (r.manche === "price") {
        if (!["higher", "lower"].includes(p.answer)) fail("Scegli HIGHER o LOWER");
        const result2 = { done: true, choice: p.answer };
        r.answers[s.id] = {
          ...result2,
          requests: { [p.request_id]: result2 }
        };
        r.revision++;
        this.settle(r);
        this.put("room", r.id, r);
        this.changed.add(r.id);
        return result2;
      }
      if (isChronology(r)) {
        const items = this.question(r).items;
        if (!Array.isArray(p.answer) || p.answer.length !== items.length || new Set(p.answer).size !== items.length || !items.every(({ id }) => p.answer.includes(id))) fail("Ordina tutti e quattro gli elementi");
        const points = correctChronology(items).reduce((sum, id, index) => sum + (p.answer[index] === id ? chronologyPoints(r) : 0), 0);
        const result2 = { done: true, choice: p.answer };
        r.answers[s.id] = { ...result2, points, requests: { [p.request_id]: result2 } };
        this.recordPoll(r, s.id, now);
        r.revision++;
        this.settle(r);
        this.put("room", r.id, r);
        this.changed.add(r.id);
        return result2;
      }
      if (isMeadow(r)) {
        const items = this.question(r).items;
        if (!Array.isArray(p.answer) || p.answer.length > items.length || new Set(p.answer).size !== p.answer.length || !p.answer.every((id) => items.some((item) => item.id === id))) fail("Selezione non valida");
        const result2 = { done: true, choice: p.answer };
        const fastest = meadowPerfect(items, p.answer) && !Object.values(r.answers).some((a2) => a2.fastest);
        r.answers[s.id] = {
          ...result2,
          points: meadowPoints(items, p.answer) + (fastest ? MEADOW_FASTEST_BONUS : 0),
          ...fastest ? { fastest: true } : {},
          requests: { [p.request_id]: result2 }
        };
        this.recordPoll(r, s.id, now);
        r.revision++;
        this.settle(r);
        this.put("room", r.id, r);
        this.changed.add(r.id);
        return result2;
      }
      if (quizOf(r) === "culture") {
        if (!cultureStage(r)) fail("Manche non disponibile");
        const [first, second] = this.question(r);
        const correct = second.population > first.population ? second : first;
        if (![first.id, second.id].includes(p.answer)) fail("Scegli una nazione");
        const result2 = { done: true, result: p.answer === correct.id ? "correct" : "wrong", choice: p.answer, points: p.answer === correct.id ? Math.ceil(Math.min(15e3, r.deadline - now) / 1e3) * 10 : 0 };
        r.answers[s.id] = { ...result2, requests: { [p.request_id]: result2 } };
        r.revision++;
        this.settle(r);
        this.put("room", r.id, r);
        this.changed.add(r.id);
        return result2;
      }
      if (typeof p.answer !== "string" || p.answer.length < 1 || p.answer.length > 80)
        fail("Inserisci un nome (massimo 80 caratteri)");
      if (answer.last && now - answer.last < 250)
        fail("Attendi prima di riprovare", 429);
      answer.last = now;
      const resolved = resolveName(p.answer);
      let result;
      if (!resolved) result = { result: "invalid" };
      else {
        if (resolved === normalize(this.question(r).canonical || this.question(r).name)) {
          answer.done = true;
          answer.points = Math.ceil(Math.min(3e4, r.deadline - now) / 1e3) * 10;
          answer.result = "correct";
        } else {
          answer.attempts++;
          answer.done = answer.attempts >= 3;
          answer.result = "wrong";
        }
        result = {
          result: answer.result,
          points: answer.points,
          attempts: answer.attempts,
          done: answer.done
        };
      }
      const keys = Object.keys(answer.requests);
      if (keys.length >= 20) delete answer.requests[keys[0]];
      answer.requests[p.request_id] = result;
      r.answers[s.id] = answer;
      r.revision++;
      this.settle(r);
      this.put("room", r.id, r);
      this.changed.add(r.id);
      return result;
    }
    if (action === "command") {
      if (!this.control(s, r))
        fail("Privilegi Host assenti, scaduti o revocati");
      const c = p.command;
      if (c === "advance") {
        const target = p.manche === 2 && Number.isInteger(p.round) ? p.round : 0;
        if (!target || quizOf(r) !== "culture") fail("Comando non disponibile");
        if (isChronology(r) && r.round === target && r.phase === "reveal" && r.chronology_view === "solution") {
          r.chronology_view = "ranking";
          r.remaining_ms = CHRONOLOGY_RANKING;
          r.deadline = now + CHRONOLOGY_RANKING;
          r.revision++;
          this.put("room", r.id, r);
          this.changed.add(r.id);
          return { ok: true };
        }
        const done = r.phase === "finished" || r.manche > 2 || r.manche === 2 && (r.round > target || r.round === target && r.chronology_view === "ranking");
        if (done) return { ok: true, unchanged: true };
        fail("Comando non disponibile");
      }
      if (p.revision !== r.revision) fail("Stato cambiato: riprova");
      if (isVault(r) && c === "next" && r.phase !== "intro" && (r.phase !== "reveal" || r.deadline - now > VAULT_REVEAL - VAULT_NEXT))
        fail("Attendi la fine della rivelazione");
      if (["start", "next"].includes(c) && quizOf(r) === "culture" && !cultureStage(r)) fail("Manche non disponibile");
      if (["question", "paused", "reveal"].includes(r.phase) && (quizOf(r) === "pokemon" && (c === "skip_to_clues" && r.round >= 1 && r.round < 7 || c === "skip_to_price" && r.manche === "clues"))) {
        this.settle(r, true);
        if (c === "skip_to_clues") this.beginClues(r);
        else this.beginPrice(r);
      } else if (c === "skip_round" && ["question", "paused", "reveal"].includes(r.phase)) {
        this.settle(r, true);
        delete r.paused_from;
        this.advanceRound(r, now);
      } else if (c === "start" && r.phase === "lobby" || c === "next" && r.phase === "reveal" && !isTimeline(r) || c === "next" && r.phase === "intro") {
        if (!Object.keys(r.players).length) fail("Attendi un giocatore");
        this.advanceRound(r, now);
      } else if (c === "pause" && (r.phase === "question" && (isVault(r) || isTimeline(r) || now >= r.starts_at) || quizOf(r) === "culture" && r.phase === "reveal" && now < r.deadline)) {
        r.remaining_ms = Math.max(0, r.deadline - now);
        if (quizOf(r) === "culture") r.paused_from = r.phase;
        r.phase = "paused";
      } else if (c === "resume" && r.phase === "paused") {
        r.phase = r.paused_from || "question";
        r.deadline = now + r.remaining_ms;
        if (r.phase === "question" && (isVault(r) || isTimeline(r) && r.remaining_ms > roundDuration(r))) {
          r.starts_at = r.deadline - roundDuration(r);
        }
        delete r.paused_from;
      } else if (c === "end" && r.phase !== "finished") {
        if (isVault(r) && !r.vaultResult) {
          r.answers = {};
          r.settled = r.round;
        } else this.settle(r, true);
        r.phase = "finished";
        if (isVault(r)) delete r.paused_from;
      } else fail("Comando non disponibile");
      r.revision++;
      this.put("room", r.id, r);
      this.changed.add(r.id);
      return { ok: true };
    }
    fail("Operazione non disponibile", 400);
  }
  async alarm() {
    return this.ctx.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
      for (const r of this.all("room")) {
        const changed = this.settle(r);
        if (changed) await this.broadcast(r.id);
      }
      await this.schedule();
    });
  }
  webSocketMessage(ws) {
    ws.close(1008, "Usa le API per le operazioni");
  }
  async webSocketClose(ws) {
    const { room } = ws.deserializeAttachment();
    ws.close(1e3);
    await this.handleDisconnect(room);
  }
  async webSocketError(ws) {
    const { room } = ws.deserializeAttachment();
    ws.close(1011, "Riconnetti");
    await this.handleDisconnect(room);
  }
  async handleDisconnect(room) {
    await this.ctx.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () => {
      const r = this.get("room", room);
      const changed = r && isTimeline(r) && this.settle(r);
      await this.broadcast(room);
      if (changed) await this.schedule();
    });
  }
};
export {
  Goku,
  addPoints,
  index_default as default
};

}\n  }\n  async fetch(request) {\n    return this.ctx.blockConcurrencyWhile(async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        if (new URL(request.url).pathname === \"/socket\") {\n          const key =   }\n    if (!s) fail(\"Autenticazione necessaria\", 401);\n    if (action === \"license_create\") {\n      requireAdmin();\n      const hours = Number(p.hours),\n        quota =
